subject: Skyline Analytics — Subprocessor add & DPA annex merge (Order Form impact)

Subject: Request: add DataPulse as subprocessor + merge DPA annex into order form

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the hard work on the order form. Two quick asks from our side before we sign:

1) We need to add one additional subprocessor — DataPulse (data-processing.vendor@datapulse.com). They will handle anonymization and telemetry aggregation for Skyline features. Can you confirm Redwood's subprocessor flow-down approach and whether DataPulse can be added as a third-party under the current MSA + Order Form?

2) Our legal team would prefer the DPA annex content to be merged into the Order Form (so we have a single executable doc). I attached a redline that merges the DPA clauses into the order form (Skyline_OrderForm_v2_redlines.pdf).

Please advise what approvals you need internally and whether this will impact the start date or pricing.

Appreciate the rapid turnaround — we are aiming to sign by 12/28.

Best,
James Holloway

Folks — forwarding Skyline's request. Key points: DataPulse to be added as a downstream subprocessor; Skyline wants the DPA annex to be merged into the Order Form. They want sign-off by 12/28.

Can Legal confirm whether the merged DPA materially changes our exposure (data return, deletion timelines, audit rights)? Karthik / Sergio — procurement/ops, please advise if adding DataPulse will require a vendor onboarding checklist or additional SOC evidence.

I attached Skyline's redline and a vendor list spreadsheet they provided.

Thanks — Kim

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: add DataPulse as subprocessor + merge DPA annex into order form

Kim / team — reviewed the redline. High-level thoughts:

- Merge into Order Form: Acceptable in principle, but several operational clauses in the merged DPA change our deletion/audit timeline from 30 -> 60 days and add a new subprocessor flow-down clause that is broader than our standard MSA (specifically: a requirement that we obtain subcontractor contractual parity within 10 business days).

- DataPulse: We need evidence of SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 (recent). If Skyline expects our contract to require parity clauses, we should avoid a hard 10-business-day obligation — propose 'reasonable efforts' plus a good-faith obligation to obtain equivalent protections within a commercially reasonable timeframe.

Action items I recommend:
1) Counter-propose edits to the merged DPA: revert deletion timeline to 30 days (or add narrow carve-outs for backups), soften the subcontractor parity timeline language to "commercially reasonable efforts," and preserve our existing audit right limitations.
2) Require DataPulse to provide SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months) and an executed DPA flow-down template.
3) If Procurement flags DataPulse as "Tier 1" (access to customer data), escalate to Security for an intake review.

I'll prepare a redline showing the proposed changes and mark clauses that require exec approval.

—Rishi
Legal Counsel | Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 09:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: add DataPulse as subprocessor + merge DPA annex into order form

Thanks — quick procurement/ops note:

- DataPulse looks like a processing-only vendor (anonymization + telemetry). If they get only pseudonymized telemetry, that reduces sensitivity, but we still treat them as Tier 1 while onboarding.
- I'll start the onboarding request this morning; we will ask DataPulse for SOC 2 Type II and the standard vendor questionnaire. If they can't produce SOC2 within 48 hours, we can request compensating controls (encryption at rest, limited retention).
- Pricing: merging the DPA into the Order Form introduces a few legal-linked SLAs; if Skyline insists on deletion windows beyond standard, that may create a small per-seat uplift. I'll flag to Finance if Legal pushes deletion to 60 days.

Please confirm whether Legal will accept the "commercially reasonable efforts" language in place of 10 business days so we can return a single redline to Skyline.

Karthik
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: James Holloway <james.holloway@skyline-analytics.com>
Cc: marta.ruiz@skyline-analytics.com, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: add DataPulse as subprocessor + merge DPA annex into order form

Hi James / Marta — thank you for the redline and the speedy ask. Short update / plan of record: 

1) Legal redline: Rishi will provide a redline of your merged DPA that:
   - restores the standard 30-day deletion window (with explicit backup carve-outs) or, if Skyline prefers, a limited 60-day exception in exchange for a documented backup retention schedule;
   - replaces the 10-business-day subcontractor parity obligation with "commercially reasonable efforts" plus a required flow-down DPA template and evidence of execution;
   - preserves our existing audit-right limitations (reasonable notice, limited scope).

2) Procurement/Onboarding: Karthik will initiate DataPulse onboarding and request SOC 2 Type II (or compensating controls). If DataPulse cannot produce SOC 2 within the onboarding window, Procurement will propose compensating technical controls.

3) Commercial impact: If Legal's redline requires exceptions (e.g., 60-day deletion), Procurement will evaluate pricing impact and route to Finance for a quick approval. Karthik expects to have an initial vendor intake by EOD 12/21.

Next steps: Rishi will upload the redline (DPA_Annex_Skyline.docx) by EOD 12/20; Karthik will share the vendor intake tracker and DataPulse evidence link when received. We will produce a single consolidated redline for Skyline to review by 12/21.

For transparency, I've attached the consolidated redlines and the subprocessor list. If Skyline is comfortable with the proposed "commercially reasonable efforts" approach, that will materially speed closing.

DocuSign intent link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/skyline-orderform-ds-1147

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Contracts Program Manager | Redwood Inference
